paper: GenZ-ICP: Generalizable and Degeneracy-Robust LiDAR Odometry Using an Adaptive Weighting (RA-L 2025)
recorded_with: reproduce.py: genz-icp from PyPI in reproductions/.venvs/genz, python API with the package's pre-tuned kitti.yaml, KITTI odometry 00-10 (23,201 frames) shared with 01-02
note: Table III, p.5 of the paper: relative translational error on KITTI 00-10 is 0.51 % for GenZ-ICP and 0.50 % for KISS-ICP. Measured here: 0.52 % and 0.53 % respectively, i.e. the published value is reproduced and the two methods stay tied. The shipped kitti.yaml is required: the generic defaults give 5.23 % on sequence 04 instead of 0.40 %.

paper_reported.status: REPRODUCED - 0.52 % measured on the official sequences

environment.package: genz-icp from PyPI (python 3.12 venv) + pyyaml; the [all] extra is not needed
environment.config: kitti.yaml shipped inside the package (deskew false, voxel 0.6, planarity 0.18)
environment.workaround: save_poses_tum_format / NumPy 2 shape-(1,) timestamp - substituted, not patched
environment.data: KITTI odometry 00-10 via 01-02's byte-range fetch of the official zip
